title: For non-carcinogenic molecules containing sulfur atoms with double bonds, l
question: For non-carcinogenic molecules containing sulfur atoms with double bonds, list the top 5 molecules in alphabetical order along with the count of their nitrogen atoms and the percentage of carbon atoms among all atoms in those molecules.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS nitrogen_count,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a2.XCL_002
    FROM atom AS a2
    INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON a2.XCL_002 = b2.XCL_005
    WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 's' AND b2.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY m.XCL_010 ASC
LIMIT 5

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS nitrogen_count,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a2.XCL_002
    FROM atom AS a2
    INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON a2.XCL_002 = b2.XCL_005
    WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 's' AND b2.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY m.XCL_010 ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS nitrogen_count,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
FROM molecule AS m
INNER JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a2.XCL_002
    FROM atom AS a2
    INNER JOIN bond AS b2 ON a2.XCL_002 = b2.XCL_005
    WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 's' AND b2.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY m.XCL_010 ASC
LIMIT 5

The execution succeeded with 5 rows and 3 columns as expected.

This matches the historical program pattern for identifying sulfur atoms in double bonds.

Measure grain: The main query joins molecule to atom and groups by molecule_id, so each atom contributes once per molecule. The nitrogen count and carbon percentage are computed over all atoms in the eligible molecules, not just the sulfur atoms or double-bonded atoms.

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT 
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'n' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS nitrogen_count,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'c' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS carbon_percentage
FROM molecule m
INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
  AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT a2.XCL_002 FROM atom a2 WHERE a2.XCL_003 = 's'
  )
  AND m.XCL_010 IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 FROM bond b WHERE b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY m.XCL_010 ASC
LIMIT 5

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nitrogen_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.XCL_001)) AS carbon_percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM atom a_sulfur
      JOIN connected c ON a_sulfur.XCL_001 = c.XCL_008
      JOIN bond b ON c.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
      WHERE a_sulfur.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
        AND a_sulfur.XCL_003 = 'S'
        AND b.XCL_006 = '='
  )
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY m.XCL_010 ASC
LIMIT 5
